video_title: OG Anunoby for Finals MVP! Boogie, Chandler & Lou on Tip-In BREATEST Playoff Moment EVER??

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: OG Anunoby is playing at a Finals MVP level
quotes.excerpt: It's time to talk about OG Anunoby and him being this Finals MVP conversation
quotes.quote: We have had conversations about Jalen Brunson, we have had conversations about Karl-Anthony Towns. It is time to talk about OG Anunoby and him being this Finals MVP conversation, especially after the game that he had last night, especially after the effort that he showed just to have the will of not wanting to lose a game when you get so close to it and not leaving without it.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: De'Aaron Fox was instructed to double-team Jalen Brunson
quotes.excerpt: De'Aaron Fox was clearly told to come and double-team Jalen Brunson and try and take the ball
quotes.quote: It is easy to pile on De'Aaron Fox this morning. Their defensive scheme was to put no one on the ball, which I thought was weird. Put a big guy, put Victor Wembanyama or someone on the ball to maybe get a deflection or a steal. But then obviously they wanted to take the ball out of Jalen Brunson's hands, so De'Aaron Fox comes to double-team and that lets OG Anunoby just run to the basket free. So it looks like a missed box-out, it was not, and I know people are going nuts on De'Aaron Fox for a certain play. He was clearly told to come and double-team Jalen Brunson and try and take the ball out of his hands.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: OG Anunoby has positioned himself for Finals MVP
quotes.excerpt: I think OG Anunoby is definitely positioned himself to be considered for Finals MVP
quotes.quote: I think OG Anunoby is definitely positioned himself to be considered for Finals MVP. I thought in the beginning, Karl-Anthony Towns was kind of leading the way setting the tone for this Knicks group and things were flowing for him well, especially when they took the 2-0 lead. Early on you kind of see Karl-Anthony Towns doing his thing and it is like, oh this is an easy decision. He is carrying the team, he is playing very well, shooting percentages are really good, numbers are good to back it up, defense was on par. He was doing a great job against Victor Wembanyama early on in this series.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: OG Anunoby shows no fear attacking Victor Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: Out of everybody on the Knicks team, OG Anunoby has zero fear of Victor Wembanyama
quotes.quote: Out of everybody on the Knicks team, OG Anunoby has zero fear of Victor Wembanyama. He is the one guy that attacks Victor Wembanyama every opportunity that he gets. Whether he is going to shoot a three, he is not worried about the close-out, whether he is putting it on the ground, finishing strong at the rim, he is the one guy that has been able to attack Victor Wembanyama and show some weaknesses in his defensive game when it comes to just somebody constantly attacking him.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Game 4 was one of the best playoff games ever
quotes.excerpt: It was one of the best playoff games I have ever seen
quotes.quote: It was one of the best playoff games I have ever seen. So yeah, I would say for sure, in my lifetime, in my era that I have been watching the NBA, I do not remember a better game that was so bad and such a blowout to such a turnaround.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Jose Alvarado's impact off the bench was crucial
quotes.excerpt: Jose Alvarado came in and he completely changed the game with just his effort and his energy
quotes.quote: Jose Alvarado came in and he completely changed the game with just his effort and his energy and some big buckets. A lot of people do not like to talk about that because they are going to talk about Jalen Brunson, they are going to talk about OG Anunoby's tip-in, they are going to talk about all the mistakes that the Spurs made. But man, Jose Alvarado came in and he completely changed the game with just his effort and his energy and some big buckets.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: Spurs' loss was due to overconfidence and lack of adjustments
quotes.excerpt: They got caught up in having too much confidence in his group and not making adjustments
quotes.quote: Everybody is going to share the blame in this one. They did not adjust. I think that he just got caught up in having too much confidence in his group and not making adjustments when they were making that run. When you drink the Kool-Aid and you go up 29 points and you have the team that you have, you kind of get tricked into thinking they are playing better than they are playing and they are going to be able to withstand these runs. I do not think he made adjustments and all the whole while, I thought Mike Brown, every single play down the court, he adjusted to one thing, adjusted to another. He did not allow them to play the foul game with Mitchell Robinson.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitch Johnson's coaching inexperience led to substitution errors
quotes.excerpt: His substitution patterns were a little off with Dylan Harper, I think he kept him out
quotes.quote: His substitution patterns were a little off with Dylan Harper, I think he kept him out for way too long. He did have two timeouts there at the end where I was surprised he did not burn one earlier when they were going on that run and they were consistently just getting bad possessions and the turnovers by De'Aaron Fox. Then he would dribble off OG Anunoby's foot and then just kind of hoist a long three. It is like you could tell their offense was getting slowed down and stagnant. Obviously it is easier for me to sit here from the outside looking in and be like, man, call a timeout, get everyone settled down, but at the end of the day, he is not on the floor.

quotes.speaker: Michelle Beadle
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks fans throwing eggs at Victor Wembanyama is unacceptable
quotes.excerpt: Knicks fans continue to show their ass because they waited at the hotel for the Spurs
quotes.quote: Knicks fans continue to show their ass because they waited at the hotel for the Spurs. I mean, they are just the worst group of people in the world, throwing eggs. So if you lose the game, you burn it down and start fights. If you win a game, you still cannot handle it. Like, what is wrong with you animals? Seriously.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks fans' behavior toward Victor Wembanyama is unacceptable
quotes.excerpt: When it comes to the Knicks fans, the bad apples are getting the bulk of the highlights
quotes.quote: When it comes to the Knicks fans, the bad apples are getting the bulk of the highlights as far as when they do win games. So I do not want to sit here and be small-minded and group them all together and just say Knicks fans are horrible. I am pretty sure there are some good fans, I am pretty sure there are some fans handling their selves in the correct way, the correct manner. But to the ones that are not, kick rocks playing traffic. It is unacceptable behavior. I do not think any player deserves that. These guys are going out here risking their bodies, risking their health to entertain these fans. Your entertainment is within the game. After the game is over, all the extracurricular should be left in the arena.
